day_shape: 71 items: CENTCOM confirms 2 US service members killed and 1 missing after Iranian strikes on Jordan base, new US airstrikes on Iran ordered by Trump, Khamenei message vows 'unforgettable lessons', Iran International reports 7th night of US strikes on southern Iran bridges/rail.

threads.label: US-Iran direct strikes escalate
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced two US service members killed and one missing after Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks on a Jordan base on 17 July, and said new US airstrikes on Iran began at 6pm ET on the Commander in Chief's direction. Iran International reported a seventh consecutive night of US strikes destroying bridges, tunnels and rail links across southern Iran toward the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Iranian claims of attacks on US bases
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran claimed coordinated attacks on US military sites in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain; IRIB and Defa Press posted claims that Kuwaiti air defences were engaging missiles and drones and that Iran's army struck US bases including Al-Udeid (Qatar), Al-Kharj (Saudi Arabia) and Al-Azraq (Jordan). Defa Press and IRIB also claimed an MQ-9 drone was shot down over Ahvaz.

threads.label: Khamenei message on Soleimani-style funeral
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a multi-part message thanking the Iranian and Iraqi people for the 'historic' funeral procession for the 'martyred leader of Iran' and warning that the American enemy will face 'unforgettable lessons.' The message also accused Washington of violating a signed presidential MoU and urged national unity, with Mojtaba Khamenei quoted by Jerusalem Post echoing the 'unforgettable lesson' line.

threads.label: Naval blockade and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted that as of 18 July it had redirected 5 commercial vessels and disabled 1 while enforcing a naval blockade against Iran, with USS Donald Cook operating in the Arabian Sea. Jerusalem Post reported commercial sailing through the Strait of Hormuz has become far more deadly in the past week, and an IRIB MP quote asserted Iran is responsible for securing commercial traffic in the strait.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and Syria
threads.summary: The IDF said a Lebanese Army soldier killed by an explosive device in Mansouri in southern Lebanon was hit by a Hezbollah-planted device, and separately struck a Hezbollah cell operating a drone near Kfar Tebnit. Jerusalem Post reported Lebanese President Joseph Aoun is visiting the White House with a Hezbollah disarmament plan, while Syria's Interior Ministry said it foiled an advanced-weapons shipment to Hezbollah.

threads.label: Gaza operations and closures
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing in Gaza airstrikes of PIJ sniper Imam Khamis Akasha Abu Brikh and Hamas Operations Headquarters commander Muhammad Taysir Ahmad Ubeid. Jerusalem Post reported the IDF closed the area around the Gaza Strip to non-residents on Sunday morning ahead of a planned 5pm Nahala movement march into Gaza.

threads.label: Iranian domestic messaging on war
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted a wave of home-front items including a government spokesperson's visit to war-damaged Bushehr province, judiciary plans to internationally pursue strikes on Iranian bridges and infrastructure, and commentary claiming Iran's missile forces shifted the balance of power. UN OCHA's Humanitarian Update No. 06 said the ceasefire held through June but localised incidents between 8-11 June injured 20 people.

events.title: CENTCOM Statement on Recently Fallen, Missing U.S. Service Members TAMPA, Fla. — On July 17, two U.S. service members in Jordan were killed in action as U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) and partner forces defended against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks. Additionally, one service member is currently missing. Four American service members were medically evacuated to Jordanian hospitals. They have since been discharged. Other personnel who were evaluated for minor injuries have returned to duty. Out of respect for the families, CENTCOM will withhold additional information, including the identities of the fallen warriors, until 24 hours after the next of kin have been notified.

The IDF says troops of the Commando Brigade spotted an enemy drone over Kfar Tebnit. The Israeli Air Force then launched searches in the area, and identified several Hezbollah operatives who were operating the drone, while hiding near Israel's security zone. The IAF then struck and killed the Hezbollah operatives "to remove the threat to our forces," the army says.
